name: COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation
summary: COSMOS Pharmaceutical Corporation engages in the retail sale of pharmaceuticals, cosmetics, daily necessities, and food products in Japan. The company offers general medicines, over-the-counter drugs, energy drinks, oral and nursing care products, vitamins, health foods, diet foods, and prescriptions; and cosmetics, men's cosmetics, hair care, and bath additives products. It also provides baby products, detergents, insect repellents, air fresheners, bath and toilet products, cooking supplies, gardening supplies, household and cleaning supplies, and clothing; processed foods, daily necessities, seasonings, confectionery, beverages, and alcohol; and tobacco and other products.
